youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用使用導航App情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從輸入目的地、選路線、轉彎語音提示、走錯路重新規劃，到抵達找停車位，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Using a Navigation App phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering entering a destination, turn-by-turn guidance, rerouting in traffic, and finding parking. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try the new navigation app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts traɪ ðə nu ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃən æp./
dialogue.zh: 我們來試試那個新的導航App吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, is it free to download?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ɪz ɪt fri tə ˌdaʊnˈloʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 好呀，下載免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I already installed it last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi ɪnˈstɔld ɪt læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，我昨晚就裝好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now open it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, naʊ ˈoʊpən ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在打開吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's asking permission to use my location.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈæskɪŋ pərˈmɪʃən tə juz maɪ ˌloʊˈkeɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 它在問我能不能使用位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap allow so the GPS can work.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp əˈlaʊ sə ðə ˌdʒiːpiˈɛs kæn wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 點允許，GPS才能運作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I see a map on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ si ə mæp ən ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 好，螢幕上出現地圖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now tap the search bar at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tæp ðə sɜrtʃ bɑr æt ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 現在點最上面的搜尋列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we search first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi sɜrtʃ fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我們先搜尋哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the downtown library on Elm Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈdaʊntɑn ˈlaɪbrɛri ɑn ɛm strit./
dialogue.zh: 先找找市中心艾姆街的圖書館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I type it with the keyboard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ taɪp ɪt wɪð ði ˈkiːbɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我要用鍵盤打出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can just press the mic and speak.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn dʒʌst prɛs ðə maɪk ənd spik./
dialogue.zh: 你可以直接按麥克風說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mic heard me and filled in the address.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə maɪk hɜrd mi ənd fɪld ɪn ði əˈdɛs./
dialogue.zh: 麥克風聽懂了，地址都填好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now hit the search button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, naʊ hɪt ðə sɜrtʃ ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 完美，現在按搜尋鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that was way faster than typing.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðæt wʌz weɪ ˈfæstər ðæn ˈtaɪpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 哇，這比打字快多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The voice input works really well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə vɔɪs ˈɪnpʊt wɜrks ˈrɪli wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 語音輸入真的很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, three libraries with similar names.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, θri ˈlaɪbɛrəriz wɪð ˈsɪmɪlər neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，跳出三個名字相近的圖書館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick the first one, it's the closest.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ðə fɜrst wʌn, ɪts ðə ˈkloʊsɪst./
dialogue.zh: 選第一個，那是最近的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one shows forty minutes by car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ʃoʊz ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts baɪ kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 這個顯示開車四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal for downtown traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈnɔrməl fər ˈdaʊntɑn ˈtræfɪk./
dialogue.zh: 市中心的車流就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it's showing me different route options.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪts ˈʃoʊɪŋ mi ˈdɪfərənt ruːt ˈɑpʃənz./
dialogue.zh: 它現在給我幾條不同的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one looks the fastest?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn lʊks ðə ˈfæstɪst?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一條看起來最快？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Middle one saves about ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl wʌn seɪvz əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 中間那條能省大約十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But does that route use toll roads?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt dʌz ðæt ruːt juz toʊl roudz?/
dialogue.zh: 但那條路會經過收費路段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, there are two tolls on the highway.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛr ɑr tu toʊlz ɑn ðə ˈhaɪweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有，高速上有兩個收費站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd rather pay for the faster way.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈræðər peɪ fər ðə ˈfæstər weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我寧可花錢走快一點的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or we can take the free side streets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr wi kæn teɪk ðə fri saɪd strits./
dialogue.zh: 或者我們可以走免費的小街道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That route looks longer but less busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ruːt lʊks ˈlɔŋgər bʌt lɛs ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 那條比較長，但車流比較少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's avoid the traffic and keep it free.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts əˈvɔɪd ðə ˈtræfɪk ənd kip ɪt fri./
dialogue.zh: 我們閃開車流，也不花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then choose the second route option.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃuz ðə ˈsɛkənd ruːt ˈɑpʃən./
dialogue.zh: 那就選第二條路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can also set it to avoid highways.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈɔlsoʊ sɛt ɪt tə əˈvɔɪd ˈhaɪweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我還可以設定不走高速公路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, highways are safer for this drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈhaɪweɪz ɑr ˈseɪfər fər ðɪs draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 不用，這趟走高速比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we check the bus route too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tʃɛk ðə bʌs ruːt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 要不要也查一下公車路線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, we have the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ, wi hæv ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，我們開車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's also a walking directions option here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrs ˈɔlsoʊ ə ˈwɔkɪŋ dəˈrɛkʃənz ˈɑpʃən hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡也有步行導覽的選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can walk from the parking lot later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn wɔk frʌm ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒我們就可以從停車場走過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea. I'll save the destination for later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə. aɪl seɪv ði ˌdɛstəˈneɪʃən fər ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我把目的地先存起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the star icon to keep it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə stɑr ˈaɪkɑn tə kip ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 點星號圖示就能存著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Now I press the start button.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn. naʊ aɪ prɛs ðə stɑrt ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 好了，我現在按開始導航。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, check the voice volume first.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, tʃɛk ðə vɔɪs ˈvɑljum fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 等等，先看看語音音量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's pretty low on my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈprɪti loʊ ɑn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我手機的聲音有點小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it up so you hear every turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ʌp soʊ ju hɪr ˈɛvri tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 調大一點，每個轉彎才聽得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we change the voice from female to male?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi tʃeɪndʒ ðə vɔɪs frʌm ˈfimel tə meɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 可以把女聲換成男聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a voice option in settings.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛrs ə vɔɪs ˈɑpʃən ɪn ˈsɛtɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，設定裡有語音選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This male voice sounds clearer to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs meɪl vɔɪs saʊndz ˈklɪrər tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 這個男聲我聽起來更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, now press go.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər, naʊ prɛs ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好多了，現在按出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole trip is about twelve miles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl trɪp ɪz əˈbaʊt twɛlvaɪ maɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 整個行程大約十二英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should take forty minutes without delays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd teɪk ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts wɪˈðaʊt dɪˈleɪz./
dialogue.zh: 不塞車的話四十分鐘就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See that blue line? That's our exact route.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðæt blu laɪn? ðæts ˈaʊər ɪɡˈzækt ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 看到那條藍線了嗎？那就是我們要走的確切路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay on that line and you're fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ɑn ðæt laɪn ənd jʊr faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 沿著藍線走就沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to keep the screen on?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə kip ðə skrin ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要一直亮著螢幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it will talk even when locked.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ɪt wɪl tɔk ˈivɛn wɛn lɑkt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，螢幕鎖著它也會語音提示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm putting my phone down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪm ˈpʊtɪŋ maɪ foʊn daʊn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我要把手機放下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't look at it while driving!
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt lʊk æt ɪt waɪl ˈdraɪvɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 開車的時候不要看它！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the map is also on the car screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə mæp ɪz ˈɔlsoʊ ɑn ðə kɑr skrin./
dialogue.zh: 對，地圖也會同步到車螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That mirror view is much safer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈmɪrər vju ɪz mʌtʃ ˈseɪfər./
dialogue.zh: 那樣映出來安全多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up on the car screen already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp ɑn ðə kɑr skrin ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 已經映到車螢幕上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, plug in the charger too.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, plʌɡ ɪn ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒər tu./
dialogue.zh: 不錯，也把充電線插上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Navigation apps eat the battery fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃən æps it ðə ˈbætəri fæst./
dialogue.zh: 導航App耗電很快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why I always keep a cable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts waɪ aɪ ˈɔlweɪz kip ə ˈkeɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 所以我一定隨身帶充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new popup asks about average speed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu ˈpɑpˌʌp æks əˈbaʊt ˈævərɪdʒ spid./
dialogue.zh: 有個新視窗在問平均速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just leave it on the default.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst liv ɪt ɑn ðə dɪˈfɔlt./
dialogue.zh: 維持預設值就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, should I add a stop along the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ, ʃʊd aɪ æd ə stɑp əˈlɔŋ ðə weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 還有，要在路上加個停靠點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do you want to stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju wɑnt tə stɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 你想在哪裡停？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a coffee shop right on the route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrs ə ˈkɔfi ʃɑp raɪt ɑn ðə ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 沿路上就有一家咖啡店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add it before the library then.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ɪt bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就把它排在圖書館之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two stops show on the trip now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu stɑps ʃoʊ ɑn ðə trɪp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在行程上顯示兩個停靠點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The order looks right to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔrdər lʊks raɪt tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 我看了，順序是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss the coffee shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ mɪs ðə ˈkɔfi ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我錯過了咖啡店呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app will just skip that stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp wɪl dʒʌst skɪp ðæt stɑp./
dialogue.zh: App會直接跳過那個停靠點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Is the GPS signal strong?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf. ɪz ðə ˌdʒiːpiˈɛs ˈsɪɡnəl strɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 也是。GPS訊號強嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four bars means it's accurate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, fɔr bɑrz minz ɪts ˈækjərɪt./
dialogue.zh: 強，四格代表定位準確。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sometimes it takes a minute to lock on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmtaɪmz ɪt teɪks ə ˈmɪnɪt tə lɑk ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 有時候它要一分鐘才抓到位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait in the open, not in the garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ɪn ði ˈoʊpən, nɑt ɪn ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ./
dialogue.zh: 要在空曠處等，不要在車庫裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're in the garage, so let's move.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ɪn ðə ɡəˈrɑʒ, soʊ lɛts muv./
dialogue.zh: 我們現在在車庫，先開出去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive out and the signal will come back.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv aʊt ənd ðə ˈsɪɡnəl wɪl kʌm bæk./
dialogue.zh: 開出去訊號就會回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There we go, the blue dot is moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr wi ɡoʊ, ðə blu dɑt ɪs ˈmuvɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好了，藍點開始移動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That dot is exactly where we are.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dɑt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wɛr wi ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那個點就是我們現在的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I know which way we face?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ noʊ wɪtʃ weɪ wi feɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼知道我們面朝哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little arrow turns with the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈæroʊ tərnz wɪð ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那個小箭頭會跟著車轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, everything looks ready to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ lʊks ˈrɛdi tə ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，看來一切就緒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start the engine and pull out.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt ði ˈɛndʒən ənd pʊl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 發車，開出去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right now is the best time to leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt naʊ ɪz ðə bɛst taɪm tə liv./
dialogue.zh: 現在正是出發的最好時機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We should go now, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʊd ɡoʊ naʊ, ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在就該走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One second, I'm switching to day mode.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd, aɪm ˈswɪtʃɪŋ tə deɪ moʊd./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我切成日間模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night mode is too dim for daytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt moʊd ɪz tu dɪm fər ˈdeɪˌtaɪm./
dialogue.zh: 白天用夜間模式實在太暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Map colors look so much clearer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæp ˈkələrz lʊk soʊ mʌtʃ ˈklɪrər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在地圖的顏色清楚多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? The destination flag is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ði ˌdɛstəˈneɪʃən flæɡ ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 看到了嗎？目的地的旗子就在那。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I zoomed out to see the whole route.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ zumd aʊt tə si ðə hoʊl ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 我縮小畫面看整條路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, pinch the screen to zoom again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, pɪntʃ ðə skrin tə zum əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好，用兩指捏放就能再縮放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we see traffic ahead on this map?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi si ˈtræfɪk əˈhɛd ɑn ðɪs mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 這張地圖看得到前面的路況嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, red lines mean heavy congestion.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, rɛd laɪnz min ˈhɛvi kənˈdʒɛstʃən./
dialogue.zh: 可以，紅線代表嚴重堵塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our route shows green all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ruːt ʃoʊz ɡrin ɔl ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的路線一路都是綠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you, no traffic delays today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ju, noʊ ˈtræfɪk dɪˈleɪz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 真幸運，今天沒有塞車延遲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a small orange patch near Main Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrs ə smɔl ˈɔrɪndʒ pætʃ nɪr meɪn strit./
dialogue.zh: 主街附近有一小塊橘色路段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's just a slow light, no big deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts dʒʌst ə sloʊ laɪt, noʊ bɪɡ dil./
dialogue.zh: 那只是紅燈比較慢，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I trust these arrival-time updates?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ trʌst ðiz əˈraɪvəl taɪm ʌpˈdeɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 這些抵達時間更新可信嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly yes, they change with live traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli jɛs, ðeɪ tʃeɪndʒ wɪð laɪv ˈtræfɪk./
dialogue.zh: 大致可信，會隨即時路況變動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it says twelve forty for arrival.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt sɛz twɛlvaɪ ˈfɔrti fər əˈraɪvəl./
dialogue.zh: 現在顯示十二點四十分抵達。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we'll beat the lunch rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, wil bit ðə lʌntʃ rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們可以避開午餐人潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, navigation started. It says head north.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃən ˈstɑrtɪd. ɪt sɛz hɛd nɔrθ./
dialogue.zh: 好，導航開始了，它說往北走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which street are we on right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ strit ɑr wi ɑn raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在在哪條街上？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is Oak Avenue, the wide one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz oʊk ˈævəˌnju, ðə waɪd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這是橡樹大道，寬的那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then follow it for two miles straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈfɑloʊ ɪt fər tu maɪlz streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就沿著它直開兩英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left turn coming up pretty soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft tɜrn ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp ˈprɪti sun./
dialogue.zh: 左轉彎很快就要到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where exactly is that left turn?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz ðæt lɛft tɜrn?/
dialogue.zh: 那個左轉具體在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the light, onto Fifth Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə laɪt, ˈɑntu faɪf strit./
dialogue.zh: 在紅綠燈那裡，轉進第五街。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get into the left lane now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ˈɪntu ðə lɛft leɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在就切到左側車道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm in the middle lane. Is that wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl leɪn. ɪz ðæt rɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我在中間車道，這樣不對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, move left before the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, muv lɛft bɪˈfɔr ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，過燈之前先往左移。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Changing lanes, signal on, all clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ leɪnz, ˈsɪɡnəl ɑn, ɔl klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 正在換道，打了方向燈，沒車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice and easy, that's it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ənd ˈizi, ðæts ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 漂亮又輕鬆，就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight hundred feet to the next turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈhʌndrəd fit tə ðə nɛkst tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 再過八百英尺就要轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down a little for the turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ daʊn ə ˈlɪtəl fər ðə tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 轉彎前稍微減點速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn left... did I make it right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn lɛft... dɪd aɪ meɪk ɪt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 左轉……我轉對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the blue line moved with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə blu laɪn muvd wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 對，藍線跟著你移動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's already counting the next street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɔlˈrɛdi ˈkaʊntɪŋ ðə nɛkst strit./
dialogue.zh: 它已經開始算下一條街了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This voice is like a quiet copilot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs vɔɪs ɪz laɪk ə ˈkwaɪət ˈkoʊpɪlət./
dialogue.zh: 這個語音就像個安靜的副駕駛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go straight for one more mile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ streɪt fər wʌn mɔr maɪl./
dialogue.zh: 再直開一英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay in this lane for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ɪn ðɪs leɪn fər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 暫時先留在這條車道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the fork, we have to keep right.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə fɔrk, wi hæv tə kip raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 分岔口那裡我們要靠右走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the split ahead? Right side.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə splɪt əˈhɛd? raɪt saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 看到前面的分岔了嗎？右邊那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, I took the right branch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, aɪ tʊk ðə raɪt bræntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 收到，我走了右邊那支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the on-ramp to the highway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði ˈɑnˌræmp tə ðə ˈhaɪweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那也是上高速的匝道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Merging onto the highway now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɜrdʒɪŋ ˈɑntu ðə ˈhaɪweɪ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 正要匯入高速公路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the speed of the traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə spid əv ðə ˈtræfɪk./
dialogue.zh: 注意旁邊車流的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speed camera ahead, it just warned us.
dialogue.phonetic: /spid ˈkæmərə əˈhɛd, ɪt dʒʌst wɔrnd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 它剛剛提醒我們，前面有測速相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, check your speed right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, tʃɛk jʊr spid raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，快看一下你的時速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm at sixty-five, the limit here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm æt ˈsɪksti faɪv, ðə ˈlɪmɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我時速六十五，這裡的上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, no tickets today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, noʊ ˈtɪkəts təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 很好，今天不會收到罰單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take exit twelve, the voice just called.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ˈɛɡzɪt twɛlv, ðə vɔɪs dʒʌst kɔld./
dialogue.zh: 語音剛報了，走十二號出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which way is exit twelve?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ ɪz ˈɛɡzɪt twɛlv?/
dialogue.zh: 十二號出口在哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's coming up after the big sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp ˈæftər ðə bɪɡ saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 在那個大招牌後面就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start moving to the right lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt ˈmuvɪŋ tə ðə raɪt leɪn./
dialogue.zh: 開始往右側車道移。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see the exit sign now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ði ˈɛɡzɪt saɪn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我看到出口指標了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your turn signal early.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz jʊr tərn ˈsɪɡnəl ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 方向燈要早點打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exit ramp here. The curve looks sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛɡzɪt ræmp hɪr. ðə kɜrv lʊks ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 匝道在這裡，彎看起來很急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app wants us at forty now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp wɑnts ʌs æt ˈfɔrti naʊ./
dialogue.zh: App現在要我們減到四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowing down, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊɪŋ daʊn, noʊ ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 正在減速，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're still on the blue line.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr stɪl ɑn ðə blu laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 你還在那條藍線上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it shows a roundabout ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ʃoʊz ə ˈraʊndəˌbaʊt əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 它顯示前方有個圓環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have you driven a roundabout before?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ˈdrɪvən ə ˈraʊndəˌbaʊt bɪˈfɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 你之前開過圓環嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, take the second exit, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈɛɡzɪt, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 有，第二個出口出去，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's check what the app says.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts tʃɛk wʌt ði æp sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 我們看看App怎麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app confirms, second exit after entering.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp kənˈfɪrms, ˈsɛkənd ˈɛɡzɪt ˈæftɚ ˈɛntərɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: App證實了，進去後走第二個出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So skip the first one, then exit.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ skɪp ðə fɜrst wʌn, ðɛn ˈɛɡzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就是錯過第一個，再出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, and watch for the crossing cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ənd wɑtʃ fər ðə ˈkrɔsɪŋ kɑrz./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，還要留意橫向的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive slow and you'll be safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv sloʊ ənd jul bi seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 開慢點就安全了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out of the roundabout, straight again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt əv ðə ˈraʊndəˌbaʊt, streɪt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 出了圓環，又是直行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much further to the coffee stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈfɜrðər tə ðə ˈkɔfi stɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 離咖啡店停靠點還有多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes away, the screen says.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts əˈweɪ, ðə skrin sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕顯示還剩五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can grab a quick cup there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn ɡræb ə kwɪk kʌp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在那裡快速喝一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lane guidance shows two lanes ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə leɪn ˈɡaɪdəns ʃoʊz tu leɪnz əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 車道引導顯示前面有兩條道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one does the app highlight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn dʌz ði æp ˈhaɪˌlaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: App亮起的是哪一條？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right one is highlighted, for the next turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wʌn ɪz ˈhaɪˌlaɪtɪd, fər ðə nɛkst tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 亮起的是右邊那條，為了下一個轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stay where you are.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn steɪ wɛr ju ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那就留在你現在的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same instruction came twice just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ɪnˈstrʌkʃən keɪm twaɪs dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 同樣的指令剛剛唸了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some turns need extra warning time.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm tɜrnz nid ˈɛkstrə ˈwɔrnɪŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 有些轉彎需要多一點提醒時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one is easy, just right at the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ɪz ˈizi, dʒʌst raɪt æt ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這個簡單，就在燈號右轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're doing great, keep going.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈduɪŋ ɡreɪt, kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你開得很好，繼續。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I mute the voice for one call?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ mjuð ðə vɔɪs fər wʌn kɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以關掉語音接個電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a small speaker button.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛrs ə smɔl ˈspikər ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 可以，有個小喇叭按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turned it back on. What did I miss?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrnd ɪt bæk ɑn. wʌt dɪd aɪ mɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 重新開了，我錯過了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It said to continue for three miles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛd tə kənˈtɪnju fər θri maɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 它說再直開三英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, a truck merged in front of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ə trʌk mɜrdʒd ɪn frʌnt əv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 噢，一輛卡車匯到我們前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your distance and stay calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jʊr ˈdɪstəns ənd steɪ kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 保持距離，別慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bridge is on our route, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə brɪdʒ ɪz ɑn ˈaʊər ruːt, lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 你看，我們的路線上會經過一座橋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that a bridge toll too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə brɪdʒ toʊl tu?/
dialogue.zh: 那過橋也要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, this bridge is completely free.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðɪs brɪdʒ ɪz kəmˈplitli fri./
dialogue.zh: 不，這座橋完全免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I hate paying at bridges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ heɪt ˈpeɪɪŋ æt ˈbrɪdʒəz./
dialogue.zh: 還好，我討厭過橋花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's counting down to the turn now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkaʊnt daʊn tə ðə tɜrn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它現在在倒數轉彎距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five hundred feet, get ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈhʌndrəd fit, ɡɛt ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 五百英尺，準備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right onto Harbor Road, the voice says.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈɑntu ˈhɑrbər roʊd, ðə vɔɪs sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 語音提示右轉進港灣路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That street is narrow, go slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt strit ɪz ˈnæroʊ, ɡoʊ sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那條街很窄，開慢點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm on it. The line matches again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ɑn ɪt. ðə laɪn ˈmætʃəz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我在路上了，藍線又吻合了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you're right on course.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, jʊr raɪt ɑn kɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 完美，你完全在正確航線上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did it say caution just now?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dɪd ɪt seɪ ˈkɔʃən dʒʌst naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 它剛剛為什麼說小心？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a sharp bend or a school zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ə ʃɑrp bɛnd ɔr ə skul zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 可能是急彎或學校區域。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, a school crossing sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz, ə skul ˈkrɔsɪŋ saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 在那兒，學校穿越標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's why it warned you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæts waɪ ɪt wɔrnd ju./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以它才提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The estimated time jumped to forty-five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛstəˌmeɪtɪd taɪm dʒʌmpt tə ˈfɔrti faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 預估時間跳到了四十五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did traffic get worse ahead?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈtræfɪk ɡɛt wɜrs əˈhɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 前面的路況變差了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A red patch just appeared on the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɛd pætʃ dʒʌst əˈpɪrd ɑn ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 地圖上剛出現一塊紅色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the app will suggest another way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ði æp wɪl səɡˈdʒɛst əˈnʌðər weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 也許App會建議另一條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, it still wants this route.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, ɪt stɪl wɑnts ðɪs ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，它還是想走這條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep driving and watch closely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ˈdraɪvɪŋ ənd wɑtʃ ˈkloʊsli./
dialogue.zh: 那就繼續開，密切注意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Light traffic on the back roads now.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt ˈtræfɪk ɑn ðə bæk roudz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在鄉間小路車流很稀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But those roads add two miles.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðoʊz roudz æd tu maɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 但那些路會多兩英里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth two more miles to keep rolling.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ tu mɔr maɪlz tə kip ˈroʊlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 能一路順暢，多兩英里也值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could ask it to reroute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊd æsk ɪt tə riˈraʊt./
dialogue.zh: 你可以叫它重新規劃路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a button that says alternate route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrs ə ˈbʌtən ðæt sɛz ˈɔltərˌnət ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 有個按鈕寫著替代路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it and compare the times.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt ənd kəmˈpɛr ðə taɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 試試看，比較一下時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New route shows thirty-eight minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ruːt ʃoʊz ˈθɜrti eɪt ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 新路線顯示三十八分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That beats the delay on this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bits ðə dɪˈleɪ ɑn ðɪs wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那比這條的延遲划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I switch right now, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ swɪtʃ raɪt naʊ, ðoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 不過我現在就要換嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the next left to join it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, teɪk ðə nɛkst lɛft tə dʒɔɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 要，下個左轉就能接上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm turning onto Maple Drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪm ˈtɜrnɪŋ ˈɑntu ˈmeɪpəl draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 好，我左轉進楓樹道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? The app is following you again.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ði æp ɪz ˈfɑloʊɪŋ ju əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 看到了嗎？App又跟上你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much smoother roads over here.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈsmuðər roudz ˈoʊvər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這邊的路順暢多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, and it's quieter too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs, ənd ɪts ˈkwaɪətər tu./
dialogue.zh: 選得好，而且這裡更安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I just missed that turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, aɪ dʒʌst mɪst ðæt tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我剛剛錯過那個轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the app notice right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ði æp ˈnoʊtɪs raɪt əˈweɪ?/
dialogue.zh: App馬上就發現了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen flashes recalculating route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ˈflæʃɪz rɪˈkælkjəˌleɪtɪŋ ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕一直跳著重新計算路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it's finding a new way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪts ˈfaɪndɪŋ ə nu weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那是說它在找新的走法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't stop here, keep driving slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt stɑp hɪr, kip ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 別在這停，繼續慢慢開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where does the new route send us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə nu ruːt sɛnd ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 新路線要帶我們去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A U-turn at the light is next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ju tɜrn æt ðə laɪt ɪz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 下一步是在燈號那裡回轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you make that U-turn legally?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju meɪk ðæt ju tɜrn ˈliɡəli?/
dialogue.zh: 那裡可以合法回轉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, U-turns are allowed at this light.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ju tɜrnz ɑr əˈlaʊd æt ðɪs laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，這個路口允許回轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, turn around at the next light.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, tərn əˈraʊnd æt ðə nɛkst laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 好，下個路口掉頭回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm back on the blue line again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm bæk ɑn ðə blu laɪn əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我又回到藍線上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Nothing to worry about.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ˈnʌθɪŋ tə ˈwɜri əˈbaʊt./
dialogue.zh: 看吧？沒什麼好擔心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The arrival time moved back ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði əˈraɪvəl taɪm muvd bæk tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 抵達時間往後延了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still better than sitting in traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈbɛtər ðæn ˈsɪtɪŋ ɪn ˈtræfɪk./
dialogue.zh: 還是比堵在車陣裡好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're right. The old route looked awful.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr raɪt. ði oʊld ruːt lʊkt ˈɔfəl./
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，原本那條糟透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Congestion was growing on Main Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈdʒɛstʃən wʌz ˈɡroʊɪŋ ɑn meɪn strit./
dialogue.zh: 主街的堵塞一直在擴大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we pass that part on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi pæs ðæt pɑrt ɑn ðə saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們從旁邊繞過那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This street looks like a quiet neighborhood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs strit lʊks laɪk ə ˈkwaɪət ˈneɪbərˌhʊd./
dialogue.zh: 這條街看起來是安靜的住宅區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to slow down in this zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm tə sloʊ daʊn ɪn ðɪs zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 這一段該減速了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most neighborhood roads have lower limits.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈneɪbərˌhʊd roudz hæv ˈloʊər ˈlɪmɪts./
dialogue.zh: 住宅區的路段限速通常較低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the arrow is spinning on the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ði ˈæroʊ ɪz ˈspɪnɪŋ ɑn ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 等等，地圖上的箭頭在轉圈圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it lost the GPS signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt lɔst ðə ˌdʒiːpiˈɛs ˈsɪɡnəl./
dialogue.zh: 那代表它失去GPS訊號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the trees here block the signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə triz hɪr blɑk ðə ˈsɪɡnəl./
dialogue.zh: 也許是這裡的樹擋掉了訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The signal usually comes back soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ˈjuʒəwəli kʌmz bæk sun./
dialogue.zh: 訊號通常一下子就會回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more instruction came through the voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ɪnˈstrʌkʃən keɪm θru ðə vɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 語音又傳來了一條新指令。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you remember what it said?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju rɪˈmɛmbər wʌt ɪt sɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 你記得它說什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, straight until the gas station.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, streɪt ənˈtɪl ðə ɡæs ˈsteɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 記得，直開直到加油站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, follow the road until then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈfɑloʊ ðə roʊd ənˈtɪl ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好，在那之前沿路開就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the map froze for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə mæp froʊz fər ə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 你看，地圖剛剛卡住了一秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try closing the app and opening again.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ˈkloʊzɪŋ ði æp ənd ˈoʊpənɪŋ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 試著關掉App再重新打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reopened right at our exact position.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌriˈoʊpənd raɪt æt ˈaʊər ɪɡˈzækt pəˈzɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 重開後它正好停在我們現在的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, no lost settings then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, noʊ lɔst ˈsɛtɪŋz ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那設定都沒丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the route still has old arrival times.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ruːt stɪl hæz oʊld əˈraɪvəl taɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 但這條路線的抵達時間還是舊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull over and refresh the traffic info.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ˈoʊvər ənd rɪˈfrɛʃ ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈɪnfə./
dialogue.zh: 靠邊停，把路況資訊更新一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, I'll stop at that wide shoulder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, aɪl stɑp æt ðæt waɪd ˈʃoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我在那個寬路肩停下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay off the road while you fix it.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ɔf ðə roʊd waɪl ju fɪks ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 處理的時候人要離車道遠點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refreshed. Now it shows a big red zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈfrɛʃt. naʊ ɪt ʃoʊz ə bɪɡ rɛd zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 更新了，現在出現一大片紅色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that delay on our only route?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt dɪˈleɪ ɑn ˈaʊər ˈoʊnli ruːt?/
dialogue.zh: 那個延遲在我們唯一的路線上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, an accident blocked two lanes ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ən ˈæksədənt blɑkt tu leɪnz əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 對，前方車禍擋了兩條車道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long is that backup?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðæt ˈbækˌʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 車龍排了多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour of standing still, it claims.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər əv ˈstændɪŋ stɪl, ɪt kleɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 它說要原地堵一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way, we can't sit there an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ, wi kænt sɪt ðɛr ən ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 不行，我們不能在那坐一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's offering a detour through the town.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɔfərɪŋ ə ˈdiˌtaʊr θru ðə taʊn./
dialogue.zh: 它提供一條繞經小鎮的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read me the detour details first.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd mi ðə ˈdiˌtaʊr dɪˈteɪlz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先唸給我這條繞道的細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six miles more, but fifty minutes less.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks maɪlz mɔr, bʌt ˈfɪfti ˈmɪnɪts lɛs./
dialogue.zh: 多六英里，卻省五十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it, that's an easy choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt, ðæts ən ˈizi tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 走這條吧，很好選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, new route accepted. It's rerouting now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, nu ruːt əkˈsɛptɪd. ɪts riˈraʊtɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，接受新路線，它正在重新規劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch for the next turn carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ fər ðə nɛkst tɜrn ˈkɛrfəli./
dialogue.zh: 下一個轉彎要看仔細。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next turn is right at the old church.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst tɜrn ɪz raɪt æt ði oʊld tʃɜrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 下一個轉彎在老教堂那裡右轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you see the church on the map?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si ðə tʃɜrtʃ ɑn ðə mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 你在地圖上看到教堂了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's marked with a little flag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪts mɑrkt wɪð ə ˈlɪtəl flæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 有，它標著一面小旗子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Landmarks help more than street names.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlændˌmɑrks hɛlp mɔr ðæn strit neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 地標比路名更有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right onto Cedar, and we're going downhill.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈɑntu ˈsidɑr, ənd wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˌdaʊnˈhɪl./
dialogue.zh: 右轉進雪松街，開始下坡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Downhill means we'll climb back up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌdaʊnˈhɪl minz wil klaɪm bæk ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 下坡就代表待會兒要再爬升。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Why is this road so bumpy?
dialogue.phonetic: /tru. waɪ ɪz ðɪs roʊd soʊ ˈbʌmpi?/
dialogue.zh: 也是。這條路為什麼這麼顛簸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe construction, it shows a cone icon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi kənˈstrʌkʃən, ɪt ʃoʊz ə koʊn ˈaɪkɑn./
dialogue.zh: 可能在施工，它顯示了錐桶圖示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is the orange cone, one mile ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ði ˈɔrɪndʒ koʊn, wʌn maɪl əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 看到了，一英里前有橘色錐桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will the detour avoid the construction?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈdiˌtaʊr əˈvɔɪd ðə kənˈstrʌkʃən?/
dialogue.zh: 這條繞道能避開施工區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Partly, though we cross it near the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrtli, ðoʊ wi krɔs ɪt nɪr ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 只避開一部分，接近尾聲還是會經過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then just drive slow through that part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dʒʌst draɪv sloʊ θru ðæt pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 那就開慢點通過那一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed ahead, the app just warned. Really?
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd əˈhɛd, ði æp dʒʌst wɔrnt. ˈrɪli?/
dialogue.zh: App剛警告前方封路。真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you find another way around?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju faɪnd əˈnʌðər weɪ əˈraʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 還能找到別的繞法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's already a new line on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrs ɔlˈrɛdi ə nu laɪn ɑn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上已經畫好一條新路線了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast work. Where does it go?
dialogue.phonetic: /fæst wɜrk. wɛr dʌz ɪt ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 動作真快。那條路去哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Along the river road for a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈrɪvər roʊd fər ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 沿著河濱路開一陣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a pretty drive, not a bad trade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈprɪti draɪv, nɑt ə bæd treɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那段風景不錯，這樣換路不虧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's nice until the next blind corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts naɪs ənˈtɪl ðə nɛkst blaɪnd ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 開到那個視野不好的轉角就要小心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow down for that blind curve.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ daʊn fər ðæt blaɪnd kɜrv./
dialogue.zh: 過那個看不見的彎要減速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No traffic at all on the river route.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtræfɪk æt ɔl ɑn ðə ˈrɪvər ruːt./
dialogue.zh: 河濱這條路上完全沒有車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the whole line is green again.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə hoʊl laɪn ɪz ɡrin əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 看，整條線又變回綠色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock is counting the minutes back down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk ɪz ˈkaʊntɪŋ ðə ˈmɪnɪts bæk daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 預估的時間正一分一分往回調。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We might still arrive close to twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi maɪt stɪl əˈraɪv kloʊs tə twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 我們說不定還是能十二點左右到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was so worried when we got lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz soʊ ˈwɜrid wɛn wi ɡɑt lɔst./
dialogue.zh: 我們迷路時我真的好緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app handled every mess perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ˈhændəld ˈɛvri mɛs ˈpɜrfɪktli./
dialogue.zh: App把每個亂局都處理得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we check if this route has tolls?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi tʃɛk ɪf ðɪs ruːt hæz toʊlz?/
dialogue.zh: 能確認這條路線有沒有收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the route details and look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ruːt dɪˈteɪlz ənd lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 打開路線明細看一看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tolls, only two traffic lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ toʊlz, ˈoʊnli tu ˈtræfɪk laɪts./
dialogue.zh: 沒收費，只有兩個紅綠燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better than the first plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə fɜrst plæn./
dialogue.zh: 那比最初的計畫還好呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone got cold and dimmed the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɡɑt koʊld ənd dimd ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 手機變冷，螢幕自動變暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the brightness up so you can see.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈbraɪtnəs ʌp soʊ ju kæn si./
dialogue.zh: 把亮度調高，你才看得清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it's hot from the sun instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪts hɑt frʌm ðə sʌn ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 現在又被曬得發燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it out of direct light.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪt aʊt əv dəˈrɛkt laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把它移開不要曬到太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The voice keeps repeating the same turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə vɔɪs kips rɪˈpidɪŋ ðə seɪm tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 語音一直重複同一個轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That usually means you passed it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈjuʒəwəli minz ju pæst ɪt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那通常代表你又開過頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I'm right where the arrow shows.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, aɪm raɪt wɛr ði ˈæroʊ ʃoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我就在箭頭指的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ignore it, it's just confused.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˌɪɡˈnɔr ɪt, ɪts dʒʌst kənˈfjuzd./
dialogue.zh: 那就別理它，它只是短路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signal bars dropped to one again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪɡnəl bɑrz drɑpt tə wʌn əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 訊號格數又掉到一格了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tunnels often kill the GPS completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʌnəlz ˈɔfən kil ðə ˌdʒiːpiˈɛs kəmˈplitli./
dialogue.zh: 隧道常常會讓GPS完全失靈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're inside the tunnel now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈtʌnəl naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們現在進到隧道裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just feel the road for the next two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst fil ðə roʊd fər ðə nɛkst tu ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 接下來兩分鐘就憑感覺沿路開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And after the tunnel, what do I do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈæftər ðə ˈtʌnəl, wʌt du aɪ du?/
dialogue.zh: 那出了隧道之後我該怎麼開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straight to the bridge, your line is back.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt tə ðə brɪdʒ, jʊr laɪn ɪz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 直開到橋那兒，而且你的藍線回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you remember that part?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 那一段你怎麼記得的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I glanced at the map before we left.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡlænst æt ðə mæp bɪˈfɔr wi lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 出發前我掃過一眼地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Is the coffee stop still planned?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt. ɪz ðə ˈkɔfi stɑp stɪl plænd?/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。咖啡店那一站還排嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the app moved it to last.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt ði æp muvd ɪt tə læst./
dialogue.zh: 有，但App把它挪到最後了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's skip it if we're running late.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts skɪp ɪt ɪf wɪr ˈrʌnɪŋ leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 如果時間來不及，就取消那一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, the library comes first today.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri kʌmz fɜrst təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 同意，今天圖書館優先。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red zone is fully behind us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði rɛd zoʊn ɪz ˈfʊli bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那塊紅色堵車區已經徹底在我們背後了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, the rest of the drive is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks, ðə rɛst əv ðə draɪv ɪz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 放鬆，剩下的路都通暢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see the library sign up ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri saɪn ʌp əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我看到前面的圖書館招牌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And there it is, you have arrived.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɛr ɪt ɪz, ju hæv əˈraɪvd./
dialogue.zh: 到了到了，它說已經抵達目的地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's guiding me to the parking entrance now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɡaɪdɪŋ mi tə ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ ˈɛntrəns naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它正在引導我去停車場入口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is that entrance exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðæt ˈɛntrəns ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 那個入口確切位置在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just past the corner, on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pæst ðə ˈkɔrnər, ɑn ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 就在轉角過後，右手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it slow, people are walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt sloʊ, ˈpipəl ɑr ˈwɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 開慢點，有人在走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parking lot looks about half full here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt lʊks əˈbaʊt hæf fʊl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這邊的停車場已經停了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's lucky, spaces should be easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈlʌki, ˈspeɪsəz ʃʊd bi ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 算幸運，車位應該好找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do navigation apps show parking prices?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃən æps ʃoʊ ˈpɑrkɪŋ ˈpraɪsəz?/
dialogue.zh: 導航App會顯示停車費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some do, check the info card here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm du, tʃɛk ði ˈɪnfə kɑrd hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 有些會，看這裡的資訊卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one says two dollars per hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn sɛz tu ˈdɑlərz pər ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 這裡寫每小時兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap for downtown, park it already.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃip fər ˈdaʊntɑn, pɑrk ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 在市中心算便宜，快停吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a spot near the elevator.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ə spɑt nɪr ði ˈɛləˌveɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 我找到一個電梯旁的車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, which floor are we going to?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, wɪtʃ flɔr ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu?/
dialogue.zh: 不錯，我們要上哪一層？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second floor, the study rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd flɔr, ðə ˈstʌdi rumz./
dialogue.zh: 二樓，自習室那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you find the walking route inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju faɪnd ðə ˈwɔkɪŋ ruːt ˌɪnˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 你能找到室內的步行路線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Indoor maps for this place are built in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪnˈdɔr mæps fər ðɪs pleɪs ɑr bɪlt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 這個地方已經內建了室內地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better, follow the dotted line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛtər, ˈfɑloʊ ðə ˈdɑtɪd laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那更好，跟著虛線走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dotted line winds around the shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑtɪd laɪn wɪndz əˈraʊnd ðə ʃɛlvz./
dialogue.zh: 虛線會繞著書架走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long is that walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðæt wɔk?/
dialogue.zh: 那段路要走多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only three minutes from the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli θri ˈmɪnɪts frʌm ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 從車子那邊走過來只要三分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you remember where you parked?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju rɪˈmɛmbər wɛr ju pɑrkt?/
dialogue.zh: 你記得自己停在哪裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I tapped mark my parking.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ tæpst mɑrk maɪ ˈpɑrkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 記得，我按了標記停車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That drops a pin on your car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɑt drɑps ə pɪn ɑn jʊr kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那會在你的車上放個圖釘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the walk route starts from that pin.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə wɔk ruːt stɑrts frʌm ðæt pɪn./
dialogue.zh: 現在步行路線就從那個圖釘開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great for finding the car later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt fər ˈfaɪndɪŋ ðə kɑr ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 待會兒找回車子就方便了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell anyone we arrived?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛl ˈɛnɪˌwʌn wi əˈraɪvd?/
dialogue.zh: 要跟誰說我們到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, send your location to Mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɛnd jʊr ˌloʊˈkeɪʃən tə mɑm./
dialogue.zh: 要的，把位置傳給媽媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a share trip button right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrs ə ʃɛr trɪp ˈbʌtən raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡有個分享行程按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one shares our live position.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ʃɛrz ˈaʊər laɪv pəˈzɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 這個會讓她看到我們的即時位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, she got an ETA link by text.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ʃi ɡɑt ən i ti ˈeɪ lɪŋk baɪ tɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 好了，她用簡訊收到預估抵達連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll stop calling to check now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil stɑp ˈkɔlɪŋ tə tʃɛk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她現在就不會一直打電話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app asked me to rate this route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp æskt mi tə reɪt ðɪs ruːt./
dialogue.zh: App請我替這條路線評分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you drive it smoothly?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju draɪv ɪt ˈsmuðli?/
dialogue.zh: 你這一趟開得順嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly, except for our two wrong turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli, ɪkˈsɛpt fər ˈaʊər tu rɔŋ tərnz./
dialogue.zh: 大致順利，除了那兩次轉錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it four stars and a note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt fɔr stɑrz ənd ə noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 給它四顆星，再附個備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote that signs were hard to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt ðæt saɪnz wɜr hɑrd tə si./
dialogue.zh: 我寫了路牌不容易看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps the next driver a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps ðə nɛkst ˈdraɪvər ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 那對下一個司機很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I save this route for another day?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ seɪv ðɪs ruːt fər əˈnʌðər deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 這條路線能存起來改天用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, save it under my drives.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, seɪv ɪt ˈʌndər maɪ draɪvz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，存到我的駕駛清單裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, one tap keeps everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaʊnd ɪt, wʌn tæp kips ɛvˈriθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，點一下全都存住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handy for the weekend drive back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhændi fər ðə ˈwikˌɛnd draɪv bæk./
dialogue.zh: 週末要開回來就派得上用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Battery is down to twenty percent now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbætəri ɪz daʊn tə ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 電力現在只剩兩成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plug in before we start the return.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ ɪn bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt ðə rɪˈtɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 回程開始前先插上充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The library visit is only one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri ˈvɪzɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 我們在圖書館只待一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then set the return route now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɛt ðə rɪˈtɜrn ruːt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那就現在先把回程路線設好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already typing home into the search bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ˈtaɪɪŋ hoʊm ˈɪntu ðə sɜrtʃ bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我已經在搜尋列打「家」了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it know our address yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt noʊ ˈaʊər əˈdrɛs jɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 它知道我們的地址了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I saved home when we set up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ seɪvd hoʊm wɛn wi sɛt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 有，一開始設定我就存了家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tap and it plans the drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tæp ənd ɪt plænz ðə draɪv./
dialogue.zh: 點一下它就規畫好開車路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Return route says thirty-nine minutes tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜrn ruːt sɛz ˈθɜrti naɪn ˈmɪnɪts təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚的回程顯示三十九分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Traffic is picking up near the exit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtræfɪk ɪz ˈpɪkɪŋ ʌp nɪr ði ˈɛɡzɪt./
dialogue.zh: 出口附近的車流開始變多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Details warn of heavy roads after five.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈteɪlz wɔrn əv ˈhɛvi roudz ˈæftər faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 明細裡警告五點以後路會很塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll leave before that rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil liv bɪˈfɔr ðæt rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我們會趕在那波尖峰前離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we avoid the accident street again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi əˈvɔɪd ði ˈæksədənt strit əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 還要避開車禍那條街嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app already marked it as cleared.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ɔlˈrɛdi mɑrkt ɪt æz klɪrd./
dialogue.zh: App已經把它標成通行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleared means we can use the main route?
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪrd minz wi kæn juz ðə meɪn ruːt?/
dialogue.zh: 通行代表能走原本那條？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it's the fastest way home.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ənd ɪts ðə ˈfæstɪst weɪ hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 對，而且那是回家最快的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll compare both routes before we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kəmˈpɛr boʊθ ruːts bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 出發前我會比較兩條路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Compare them on the big screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈpɛr ðɛm ɑn ðə bɪɡ skrin./
dialogue.zh: 就在大螢幕上比較吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car screen shows both times side by side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr skrin ʃoʊz boʊθ taɪmz saɪd baɪ saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 車螢幕把兩個時間並排顯示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one wins?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn wɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一條贏了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Main Street, eight minutes faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪn strit, eɪt ˈmɪnɪts ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 主街，快八分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then drive it, the river can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn draɪv ɪt, ðə ˈrɪvər kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就開那條，河濱路不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's end this trip inside the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɛnd ðɪs trɪp ɪnˈsaɪd ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 我們就在App裡結束這趟行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did it ask to end the trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt æsk tə ɛnd ðə trɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 它有確認要結束行程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it shows the whole drive summary.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ʃoʊz ðə hoʊl draɪv ˈsʌməˌmɛri./
dialogue.zh: 有，它顯示整趟的行車摘要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miles driven and time saved?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪlz ˈdrɪvən ənd taɪm seɪvd?/
dialogue.zh: 有行駛的英里數和省下的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen miles, and we beat the estimate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin maɪlz, ənd wi bit ði ˈɛstɪˌmeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十五英里，而且比預估還早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, the detour really paid off.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, ðə ˈdiˌtaʊr ˈrɪli peɪd ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 不錯，那次繞路真的值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our two reroutes are logged too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər tu riˈraʊts ɑr lɑɡd tu./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩次改道也被記錄下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep that history, it's useful later.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðæt ˈhɪstəri, ɪts ˈjusfəl ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 留著那段紀錄，以後有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find past trips?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ faɪnd pæst trɪps?/
dialogue.zh: 過去的行程要去哪裡看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In your profile, under recent drives.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn jʊr ˈproʊfaɪl, ˈʌndər ˈrisənt draɪvz./
dialogue.zh: 在你的個人頁面，最近行程裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, everything saved. Phone on charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ˈɛvriθɪŋ seɪvd. foʊn ɑn tʃɑrdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 好，全都存好了，手機也充上電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, don't forget the parking ticket machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, doʊnt fərˈɡɛt ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ ˈtɪkət məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 噢，別忘了那邊的停車繳費機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, two hours, coins or card?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, tu ˈaʊərz, kɔɪnz ɔr kɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 對，兩小時，用硬幣還是卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card is easier, tap and go.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɪz ˈiːziər, tæp ənd ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 刷卡方便，點一下就搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ticket printed, I'll put it on the dash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪkət ˈprɪntɪd, aɪl pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə dæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 收據印出來了，我放儀表板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now I can head inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, naʊ aɪ kæn hɛd ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在我可以進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, should we download an offline map?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ʃʊd wi ˌdaʊnˈloʊd ən ˌɔfˌlaɪn mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們要下載離線地圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why would you need an offline map?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ wʊd ju nid ən ˌɔfˌlaɪn mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 你為什麼會需要離線地圖？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Data is weak out in the countryside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪtə ɪz wik aʊt ɪn ðə ˈkʌntrɪˌsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 鄉下的網路訊號很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, download the whole region.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt, ˌdaʊnˈloʊd ðə hoʊl ˈridʒən./
dialogue.zh: 有道理，把整個地區都下載。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one hundred megabytes to download.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈmɛɡəˌbaɪts tə ˌdaʊnˈloʊd./
dialogue.zh: 只要下載一百MB而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small size, do it while on wifi.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl saɪz, du ɪt waɪl ɑn ˈwaɪfaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 檔案不大，趁有WiFi的時候下載。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, so navigation works without service.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, soʊ ˌnævɪˈɡeɪʃən wɜrks wɪˈðaʊt ˈsɜrvəəs./
dialogue.zh: 好了，沒訊號也能導航。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my backup plan for next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ ˈbækˌʌp plæn fər nɛkst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 那是我下個月的備案了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check alerts for speed cameras too.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts tʃɛk əˈlɜrts fər spid ˈkæmərəz tu./
dialogue.zh: 測速相機的提醒也看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They only turn on with the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈoʊnli tɜrn ɑn wɪð ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 那些提醒只會在App開著時響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And notifications? I don't want spam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd noʊˌtɪfəˈkeɪʃənz? aɪ doʊnt wɑnt spæm./
dialogue.zh: 那推播通知呢？我不要廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn off news, keep only traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɔf nuz, kip ˈoʊnli ˈtræfɪk./
dialogue.zh: 把新聞關掉，只留路況通知。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only traffic alerts on, that's cleaner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈtræfɪk əˈlɜrts ɑn, ðæts ˈklinər./
dialogue.zh: 只開路況提醒，這樣清爽多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the settings are truly finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈsɛtɪŋɡz ɑr ˈtruɪli ˈfɪnɪʃt./
dialogue.zh: 現在設定真的全部搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you in an hour in the lobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ɪn ən ˈaʊər ɪn ðə ˈlɑbi./
dialogue.zh: 一小時後大廳見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive back safe and watch for lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv bæk seɪf ənd wɑtʃ fər laɪts./
dialogue.zh: 回來的路上開慢點，注意號誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll keep the voice guidance on low.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kip ðə vɔɪs ˈɡaɪdəns ɑn loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我會把語音導航開小聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That way you still hear every turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt weɪ ju stɪl hɪr ˈɛvri tɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 這樣每個轉彎你還是聽得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye, text me when you walk out.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ, tɛkst mi wɛn ju wɔk aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 再見，走出來時傳訊給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will do. The return route is all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du. ðə rɪˈtɜrn ruːt ɪz ɔl sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 會的，回程路線都已經設好了。
